description: A casual life is a bold life . Play casually #selflove #PersonalGrowth #selfmastery
transcript: Learn how to play casually. The more that I've leaned into doing things casually, the more space and time that I have created for myself to invest in the things that require 110% from me. The more that I live casually, the more bold I become in my life, the more bold my decisions become, the more bold I allow my experiences to be because I'm not attached to the outcome. Casually living allows me to enjoy life more.
